criterion_correction.basic_identification: Account-pair same-controller discrimination and probability prediction: AP and ROC-AUC must not fall; Brier and log_loss must not rise.
criterion_correction.valid_scope: Both the average of three paired runs and the fixed s0 pair must satisfy all four observed-value guards, in addition to the original MAP and Recall@5 conditions.
criterion_correction.test_scope: The prespecified s0 candidate versus original D must satisfy all four guards and the MAP/Recall@5 conditions on independently authorized heldout data.
criterion_correction.uncertainty: Report paired group intervals for all metrics. Observed nondegradation is not proof of strict population noninferiority, and does not guarantee every domain or operating point.
criterion_correction.old_automatic_gate: Reported unchanged as diagnostic; not a new absolute retrieval acceptance gate.
